content:
Returns user authorizations for accessing a Tenable Vulnerability Management instance. Access
methods include user name and password, single sign-on (SSO) with SAML, and API. Note: All
access methods are authorized by default.
For background information about managing user authorizations, see Manage User Access
Authorizations in the Tenable Vulnerability Management User Guide.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The UUID of the user. To determine the user UUID, use the GET /users
endpoint.
